messages:
maria: quick idea: build a sandboxed preview flow for flag changes that uses shadowing + telemetry gates so product can validate behavior without impacting prod.
kevin: +1. Important: preview still consumes capacity; need explicit budget field so ops won't be surprised. :warning:
gina: two constraints: keep main routing unchanged, and siphon a sampled copy out. prefer router-level duplicate so we don't add p95 latency.
devon: router duplicate ok but must be non-blocking. If preview downstream backpressures, we must increase drop rate to protect router.
maria: API sketch: POST /v1/config/preview -> returns preview_id, sampling, budget_tokens, ttl. router accepts X-Preview-ID header or references preview in route config.
kevin: sample payload idea: {flag_change, sampling:{type:hash,rate:0.01},budget_tokens:200000,ttl_seconds:3600} response pv_xxx.
gina: add telemetry_gate: {metric:err_rate,threshold:0.02,window_mins:10} -> auto-pause. Also require opt-in per tenant for privacy-sensitive flags.
devon: dashboards: prebuilt panel grouped by preview_id+tenant. limit labels to avoid cardinality: preview_id, team. auto-ttl previews after 24h.
ops-bot: note: any preview duplicating >=1% for >5min triggers quota alerting. docs: https://intra.redwood/ops/preview-quotas
kevin: console UX: wizard for diff, cohort (hash bucket or list), sampling, budget, gates, estimate cost before start, start/stop toggle, promote -> staged rollout conversion.
gina: security: scrub PII from preview stream and block writing raw model logs. audit entry required on create: audit.preview.created.
maria: rollout plan: prototype router PR, preview_ingest pipeline, preview_eval, and Grafana panels. small internal canary first.
devon: i'll own router duplication PR and backpressure behavior.
kevin: i'll draft console wizard + alerts (80% budget warning).
gina: i'll own security gating and redact pipeline.
ops-bot: actionable: create alert preview.budget.threshold at 80% and 100% (auto-pause). assigned to oncall-alerts.
maria: thanks all — i'll write a short RFC with API schema + console mockups and schedule sync on Friday.
